dialogue.text: Welcome to Pixel Paradox. Imagine changing the entire world in just seconds.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來到 Pixel Paradox。想像一下，在短短幾秒鐘內改變整個世界。
dialogue.ja: Pixel Paradoxへようこそ。わずか数秒で世界を変えることを想像してみてください。
dialogue.local: Welcome to Pixel Paradox. Imagine changing the entire world in just seconds.
dialogue.en: Welcome to Pixel Paradox. Imagine changing the entire world in just seconds.

dialogue.text: Today, we're uncovering the incredible story of the right brother's first flight.
dialogue.zh: 今天，我們將揭開萊特兄弟首次飛行的驚人故事。
dialogue.ja: 今日はライト兄弟の最初の飛行という驚くべき物語を明らかにします。
dialogue.local: Today, we're uncovering the incredible story of the right brother's first flight.
dialogue.en: Today, we're uncovering the incredible story of the right brother's first flight.

dialogue.text: Before becoming aviation pioneers, Orville and Wilbur Wright owned a bicycle shop in Ohio.
dialogue.zh: 在成為航空先驅之前，奧維爾和威爾伯·萊特在俄亥俄州經營一家自行車店。
dialogue.ja: 航空の先駆者になる前、オーヴィルとウィルバー・ライトはオハイオ州で自転車店を経営していました。
dialogue.local: Before becoming aviation pioneers, Orville and Wilbur Wright owned a bicycle shop in Ohio.
dialogue.en: Before becoming aviation pioneers, Orville and Wilbur Wright owned a bicycle shop in Ohio.

dialogue.text: Their curiosity and engineering skills would soon change history forever.
dialogue.zh: 他們的好奇心和工程技術很快就改變了歷史。
dialogue.ja: 彼らの好奇心と技術力がまもなく歴史を永遠に変えることになります。
dialogue.local: Their curiosity and engineering skills would soon change history forever.
dialogue.en: Their curiosity and engineering skills would soon change history forever.

dialogue.text: After years of testing gliders and studying flight, they designed the right flyer in Ohio.
dialogue.zh: 經過多年測試滑翔機和研究飛行，他們在俄亥俄州設計了萊特飛行器。
dialogue.ja: 何年ものグライダーの試験と飛行の研究の後、彼らはオハイオ州でライトフライヤーを設計しました。
dialogue.local: After years of testing gliders and studying flight, they designed the right flyer in Ohio.
dialogue.en: After years of testing gliders and studying flight, they designed the right flyer in Ohio.

dialogue.text: A lightweight aircraft built with careful engineering and countless experiments.
dialogue.zh: 這是一架輕量飛機，經過細心的工程設計和無數實驗製成。
dialogue.ja: 慎重な設計と数え切れない実験によって作られた軽量の飛行機です。
dialogue.local: A lightweight aircraft built with careful engineering and countless experiments.
dialogue.en: A lightweight aircraft built with careful engineering and countless experiments.

dialogue.text: On December 17, 1903, at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, the right flyer stayed in the air for just 12,
dialogue.zh: 1903年12月17日，在北卡羅來納州的基蒂霍克，萊特飛行器僅在空中停留了12秒，
dialogue.ja: 1903年12月17日、ノースカロライナ州キティホークで、ライトフライヤーはわずか12秒間空中にとどまりました。
dialogue.local: On December 17, 1903, at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, the right flyer stayed in the air for just 12,
dialogue.en: On December 17, 1903, at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, the right flyer stayed in the air for just 12,

dialogue.text: but those 12 seconds changed the future of transportation forever.
dialogue.zh: 但這12秒永遠改變了交通的未來。
dialogue.ja: しかし、その12秒が交通の未来を永遠に変えました。
dialogue.local: but those 12 seconds changed the future of transportation forever.
dialogue.en: but those 12 seconds changed the future of transportation forever.

dialogue.text: That historic first flight covered about 120 feet. It may sound short today,
dialogue.zh: 那次歷史性的首次飛行約飛行了120英尺。今天聽起來可能很短，
dialogue.ja: その歴史的な最初の飛行は約120フィートの距離を飛びました。今では短く感じるかもしれませんが、
dialogue.local: That historic first flight covered about 120 feet. It may sound short today,
dialogue.en: That historic first flight covered about 120 feet. It may sound short today,

dialogue.text: but at the time, it proved powered flight was finally possible.
dialogue.zh: 但當時，它證明了動力飛行終於成為可能。
dialogue.ja: しかし当時、それは動力飛行がついに可能であることを証明しました。
dialogue.local: but at the time, it proved powered flight was finally possible.
dialogue.en: but at the time, it proved powered flight was finally possible.

dialogue.text: The brothers didn't stop after one flight. They completed four successful flights,
dialogue.zh: 兄弟倆並沒有在一次飛行後停止。他們完成了四次成功的飛行，
dialogue.ja: 兄弟たちは一度の飛行で止まりませんでした。彼らは4回の成功した飛行を成し遂げました。
dialogue.local: The brothers didn't stop after one flight. They completed four successful flights,
dialogue.en: The brothers didn't stop after one flight. They completed four successful flights,

dialogue.text: that same day, and each one traveled farther than the last.
dialogue.zh: 就在同一天，每次飛行的距離都比上一次更遠。
dialogue.ja: 同じ日に、そしてそれぞれの飛行は前の飛行よりも遠くへ飛びました。
dialogue.local: that same day, and each one traveled farther than the last.
dialogue.en: that same day, and each one traveled farther than the last.

dialogue.text: At first, many people doubted their achievement, but as more successful flights followed,
dialogue.zh: 起初，許多人懷疑他們的成就，但隨著更多成功的飛行接踵而至，
dialogue.ja: 最初は多くの人が彼らの偉業を疑いましたが、成功した飛行が続くにつれて、
dialogue.local: At first, many people doubted their achievement, but as more successful flights followed,
dialogue.en: At first, many people doubted their achievement, but as more successful flights followed,

dialogue.text: the world finally recognized that aviation had entered a brand new era.
dialogue.zh: 世界終於認識到航空已經進入了一個全新的時代。
dialogue.ja: 世界はついに航空が新しい時代に入ったことを認めました。
dialogue.local: the world finally recognized that aviation had entered a brand new era.
dialogue.en: the world finally recognized that aviation had entered a brand new era.

dialogue.text: From that first 12-second flight came the foundation of modern aviation. Today,
dialogue.zh: 從那次12秒的首次飛行開始，現代航空的基礎就此建立。今天，
dialogue.ja: あの最初の12秒間の飛行から現代航空の基礎が生まれました。今日では、
dialogue.local: From that first 12-second flight came the foundation of modern aviation. Today,
dialogue.en: From that first 12-second flight came the foundation of modern aviation. Today,

dialogue.text: millions of people fly every day because two brothers believed humans could soar through the sky.
dialogue.zh: 每天有數百萬人飛行，因為兩兄弟相信人類能夠翱翔天空。
dialogue.ja: 毎日何百万人もの人が飛行機に乗っています。なぜなら、二人の兄弟が人間は空を飛べると信じたからです。
dialogue.local: millions of people fly every day because two brothers believed humans could soar through the sky.
dialogue.en: millions of people fly every day because two brothers believed humans could soar through the sky.

dialogue.text: Today, the original right flyer is carefully preserved in a museum,
dialogue.zh: 今天，原始的萊特飛行器被小心地保存於博物館中，
dialogue.ja: 現在、オリジナルのライトフライヤーは博物館で大切に保存されています。
dialogue.local: Today, the original right flyer is carefully preserved in a museum,
dialogue.en: Today, the original right flyer is carefully preserved in a museum,

dialogue.text: reminding visitors how one small aircraft changed the future of human travel.
dialogue.zh: 提醒訪客一架小飛機如何改變了人類旅行的未來。
dialogue.ja: 訪れる人々に、一つの小さな飛行機が人類の旅の未来をどう変えたかを伝えています。
dialogue.local: reminding visitors how one small aircraft changed the future of human travel.
dialogue.en: reminding visitors how one small aircraft changed the future of human travel.

dialogue.text: From one successful flight in 1903, aviation has connected countries,
dialogue.zh: 自1903年那次成功的飛行以來，航空連接了各國，
dialogue.ja: 1903年の一度の成功した飛行から、航空は国々をつなげてきました。
dialogue.local: From one successful flight in 1903, aviation has connected countries,
dialogue.en: From one successful flight in 1903, aviation has connected countries,

dialogue.text: families, businesses, and cultures across every continent on earth.
dialogue.zh: 家庭、企業和文化遍及地球上的每個大陸。
dialogue.ja: 家族や企業、文化を地球上のすべての大陸で結びつけています。
dialogue.local: families, businesses, and cultures across every continent on earth.
dialogue.en: families, businesses, and cultures across every continent on earth.

dialogue.text: Amazing fact, the Wright brothers' first powered flight lasted only 12 seconds.
dialogue.zh: 驚人的事實是，萊特兄弟的首次動力飛行僅持續了12秒。
dialogue.ja: 驚くべき事実として、ライト兄弟の最初の動力飛行はわずか12秒間でした。
dialogue.local: Amazing fact, the Wright brothers' first powered flight lasted only 12 seconds.
dialogue.en: Amazing fact, the Wright brothers' first powered flight lasted only 12 seconds.

dialogue.text: Today, modern airplanes can stay in the air for more than 15 hours without stopping.
dialogue.zh: 如今，現代飛機可以連續飛行超過15小時。
dialogue.ja: 今日では、現代の飛行機は15時間以上も止まらずに空中にいられます。
dialogue.local: Today, modern airplanes can stay in the air for more than 15 hours without stopping.
dialogue.en: Today, modern airplanes can stay in the air for more than 15 hours without stopping.

dialogue.text: History proves that even the smallest breakthrough can change the world.
dialogue.zh: 歷史證明，即使是最小的突破也能改變世界。
dialogue.ja: 歴史は、どんなに小さな突破口でも世界を変えられることを証明しています。
dialogue.local: History proves that even the smallest breakthrough can change the world.
dialogue.en: History proves that even the smallest breakthrough can change the world.

dialogue.text: Thanks for watching Pixel Paradox.
dialogue.zh: 感謝收看 Pixel Paradox。
dialogue.ja: Pixel Paradoxをご覧いただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.local: Thanks for watching Pixel Paradox.
dialogue.en: Thanks for watching Pixel Paradox.
